name: Åland Islands

findings.summary: Ericsson was named sole supplier to upgrade Ålands Mobiltelefon's GSM/GPRS network to EDGE, including base-station software and a GPRS core node, with rollout from September 2004; the operator then held over half the local mobile market.
findings.analyst_inference: Equipment vendor rule: Ericsson is Swedish, so pole third whether the unit is Åland or Finland (no Finnish/Ålandic controller question arises here). Tier 3: sole-supplier contract with named counterparty, value undisclosed. Pre-2020 2G/EDGE network; current 4G/5G RAN and core vendors of Ålands Mobiltelefon and other Åland operators not established, still_current null. Single opened S1 vendor release, so medium.

findings.controller: Not stated (cable equipment vendor unnamed; owner GlobalConnect, Nordic)
findings.summary: GlobalConnect announced a roughly EUR 14m, 150 km Stockholm–Turku subsea fibre cable with a beach landing on Åland; seabed surveys and permitting were under way in 2025, with cable laying planned for 2026 and go-live by end-2026.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: spec sets cable pole by equipment vendor, which no source names. Owner GlobalConnect is Nordic, so third is likely if the vendor is European, but unconfirmed. Tier 2: surveys and permitting only; construction start not confirmed. Opened reports all relay one company release, so not independent; corroborated false. Value is in EUR; DCD's USD 16.4m conversion not recorded as announced_value_usd.
